baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins first-person respite in أُمْلِى to possessive كَيْدِى and predicates that strategy مَتِينٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The extension is not outside the strategy. Granted duration is its actuator: the operation works through time while its efficacy remains continuous.

activation_trace.role: Granting respite by lengthening time supplies the interval as an active resource rather than an empty pause.
Plotting and stratagem, including delayed consequence in its scope, makes the interval part of the operation.
Extended firmness supplies continuity, so efficacy persists across the granted span.

changed_reading.before: I postpone action, although My plan remains strong.
changed_reading.after: I act by postponing: the granted interval is the durable strategy's working span.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of temporal extension, كَيْد, and مَتِين permits strength to be read as endurance rather than sudden impact.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forceful handling becomes a sustained contest. The strategy is strong because it can keep matching, handling, and outlasting its object without needing an immediate blow.

activation_trace.role: Extended time supplies the long field over which the action is sustained.
Forceful working of a thing supplies active pressure rather than merely secret intention.
Prolonged matching or stalling makes durable opposition the functional form of strength.

changed_reading.before: The plan remains strong despite waiting.
changed_reading.after: Its strength is the capacity to sustain pressure and outlast resistance through the wait.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The time verb and مَتِين meet in a branch where a racer is allowed to advance and is then caught.
baseline_models.mechanism: Respite is a conceded lead. Apparent advance by the object of the strategy demonstrates, rather than threatens, the strategy's capacity to catch up.

activation_trace.role: Long temporal extension supplies the distance of the conceded lead.
Stratagem assigns the apparently permissive lead a directed purpose.
Giving a racer a head start and then catching up supplies the temporal geometry of controlled overtaking.

changed_reading.before: They are allowed more time before the strong plan reaches them.
changed_reading.after: They are allowed a lead whose later cancellation displays the plan's control of distance and timing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُمْلِى can widen a tether while مَتِين can strengthen by cords, with كَيْد supplying directed handling between them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The granted interval is apparent slack inside a tensioned system. More room to move does not mean release; hidden tensile control can remain or increase beneath the slack.

activation_trace.role: Widening or loosening a tether supplies the visible freedom granted by the interval.
Forceful handling supplies an operator who uses, rather than loses, the slack.
Tightening with sinew or cords supplies the concealed structural tension beneath apparent looseness.

changed_reading.before: Respite relaxes pressure for a while.
changed_reading.after: Respite gives visible slack while the underlying system remains tensioned and controlled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form أُمْلِى carries both temporal extension and dictation, while كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ can qualify the resulting sequence as purposeful and durable.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interval can be heard as authored rather than blank: time is given while a sequence is being dictated into durable form.

activation_trace.role: Dictating a written text opens an authorship channel within the same focus verb.
Stratagem gives the dictated sequence direction rather than treating it as neutral inscription.
Extended firmness makes the authored sequence durable across time.

changed_reading.after: I give time as an authored line whose unfolding belongs to My durable strategy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pen-and-lines opening and the later denial that they possess the unseen and write activate the dictation branch of أُمْلِى. Respite becomes an authored duration, while rival claims to describe or script reality are placed under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Dictation is the focus hinge that lets temporal extension also carry authored sequencing.
Stratagem turns the authored sequence into purposeful ordering.
Extended firmness gives the authored order persistence.
The sharpened writing implement supplies an explicit material channel for inscription.
Ordered written lines make sequence and record part of the surah's frame.
What is screened from sight supplies the hidden content whose possession by the opponents is questioned.
Composing letters into writing supplies the denied rival act of authoring the unseen.

structural_cues: 68:1 opens with pen and line-writing, while 68:47 asks whether they possess the unseen and therefore write.
The focus verb sits between an opening writing frame and a later challenge to rival authorship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing at both ends and a genuine dictation branch in the focus verb; I infer authored sequence -> authored duration. A live alternative is that the writing frame concerns revelation only and leaves أُمْلِى as ordinary respite.

changed_reading.before: The dictation sense is a remote focus-only polysemy.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding writing frame makes the granted interval readable as a line being authored while it unfolds.

context_deltas.mechanism: The desired reciprocal softening in 68:9 distinguishes long allowance from accommodation. The focus delay is strategic patience whose firmness specifically excludes a lubricated bargain.

activation_trace.role: Extended enjoyment supplies the apparent indulgence that could be mistaken for concession.
Forceful handling preserves active pressure during the allowance.
Firmness supplies the refusal of structural compromise.
Soft accommodation and mutual smoothing supply the rejected social mechanism against which firm delay is read.

structural_cues: The prohibition on obeying deniers in 68:8 is followed by reciprocal verb forms for mutual softening in 68:9.
The focus later combines allowance with an emphatic assertion of firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected mutual accommodation and later firm respite; I infer allowance without concession. The alternative is that 68:9 describes only prophetic conduct and does not specify the mechanics of 68:45.

changed_reading.before: Giving time may look like easing pressure or tolerating a bargain.
changed_reading.after: The interval is patient non-concession: time is granted without softening the governing strategy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence supplies a test in which an oath and exclusionary resolve form during ordinary enjoyment, sleep creates trusted latency, and cutting arrives before recognition. The focus interval therefore reads as a diagnostic chamber that lets concealed intention become actionable and visible.

activation_trace.role: Extended enjoyment supplies the normal-looking interval in which disposition can ripen.
Stratagem assigns the interval a hidden diagnostic direction.
Extended firmness lets the test remain coherent from intention through consequence.
A test that makes a condition appear supplies the diagnostic function of the delay.
The oath supplies committed intention before the result becomes visible.
Settling into trust supplies the lull in which the owners experience no immediate correction.
Cutting and separation supply the abrupt closure that exposes what the interval had developed.

structural_cues: 68:17 states the test, 68:17-18 records resolve, 68:19 marks sleep, and 68:20 presents the transformed result.
Recognition and self-indictment occur only after the delayed consequence becomes visible in 68:26-31.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, committed intent, trusted sleep, and later cutting; I infer interval -> maturation and disclosure of intent. A live alternative is that the garden episode illustrates consequence without defining every later instance of respite.

changed_reading.before: Respite merely postpones a known judgment.
changed_reading.after: Respite is diagnostic: it lets an inward disposition organize itself before consequence discloses it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners move toward their goal as capable agents, but an encircling event has already cut off the goal. This supplies a narrative realization of the focus branch in which a lead is granted and then caught.

activation_trace.role: Long duration supplies the lead during which the owners can plan and advance.
Stratagem turns the temporal lead into controlled exposure rather than lost control.
A racer granted a lead and then caught supplies the precise overtaking model.
An arriving or passing event supplies the intervention that overtakes the owners during their lull.
Severance supplies the already-completed cancellation of their expected finish.
Capability sufficient for action supplies their felt advantage immediately before discovery.

structural_cues: The owners advance from oath to morning departure while the decisive event reaches the garden first.
Their assertion of capability in 68:25 precedes recognition of loss in 68:26-27.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies advance, felt capability, an intervening event, and prior severance; I infer granted lead -> overtaking. The alternative is that the racing branch remains only a material analogy for ordinary delayed consequence.

changed_reading.before: The conceded-lead model is an isolated lexical image in مَتِين.
changed_reading.after: The garden sequence enacts that geometry: confident advance continues until a prior intervention is discovered to have overtaken it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A run of challenges grants rival judgment procedural room, then demands a binding text, reaching oath, guarantor, and disclosure. The focus strategy becomes an evidentiary enclosure: claims are allowed to extend until their own supports fail under inspection.

activation_trace.role: Temporal extension supplies room for the opposing claim to state and support itself.
Forceful handling supplies the progressive stress placed on the claim.
Firmness supplies an evidentiary structure that does not yield to assertion.
Judgment between parties supplies the forensic domain of the challenge.
A written establishment that imposes a ruling supplies the demanded documentary support.
A binding oath supplies the next possible support tested by the questions.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the personal surety demanded after text and oath.
Removal of a covering supplies the terminal disclosure where unsupported judgment becomes embodied failure.

structural_cues: The repeated questions in 68:36-41 move through judgment, book, chosen entitlement, oath, guarantor, and partners.
The sequence turns from verbal claims to bodily inability when covering is removed in 68:42-43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an escalating proof sequence and terminal disclosure; I infer procedural extension -> self-exhaustion of the claim. The alternative is a synchronic rhetorical refutation with no intended temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The strong strategy is a concealed counterplot imposed from outside.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a firm procedure that gives a claim room to produce its warrant until the claim encloses and exposes itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding promise to take them degree by degree turns temporal extension into controlled motion. Each added interval is another step within the strategy, while the route remains opaque to those moving through it.

activation_trace.role: Lengthened respite supplies the increments through which movement can continue.
Stratagem supplies the hidden direction governing those increments.
Extended and severe going supplies sustained reach over the whole course, not a stationary wait.
Taking degree by degree supplies the directional movement enacted by successive grants of time.
An indeterminate place supplies the unlocated point from which the controlled movement operates.

structural_cues: 68:44's first-person plural gradual action immediately precedes 68:45's first-person singular respite and possessive strategy.
The phrase 'from where they do not know' makes awareness asymmetric while motion continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies graded taking, an opaque where, and then extended respite; I infer each extension -> another controlled degree. The alternative is that 68:45 merely restates delay after a separate image of gradual taking.

changed_reading.before: Respite is stationary time before the strategy acts.
changed_reading.after: Respite is locomotion inside the strategy: every added span advances the stepwise taking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing near-action يَكَادُ is split-mapped both to proximity and to the focus root's stratagem branch, then aims to slide the addressee from his station. This creates an exploratory counter-kayd: their almost-effective pressure destabilizes, while the possessive focus strategy is firm and station-preserving.

activation_trace.role: The focus stratagem supplies one side of the possible formal and semantic echo.
Staying in a place supplies the stabilizing sense of firmness opposed to displacement.
Near-completion supplies the opponents' action as almost, but not finally, effective.
The non-dominant split mapping to stratagem supplies the exploratory echo with كَيْدِى without collapsing the two roots.
Sliding a thing from its station on unstable footing supplies the counter-strategy's intended displacement.

structural_cues: 68:51 joins near-action, hostile sight, attempted dislodging, hearing the reminder, and a renewed madness charge.
68:52 answers with the reminder's world-wide scope, so attempted displacement does not terminate its reach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split KWD mapping, attempted sliding, and focus firmness; I infer destabilizing near-kayd versus stabilizing firm kayd. The materially live alternative is that يَكَادُ is only an auxiliary of proximity and the split mapping carries no deliberate echo.

changed_reading.before: My firm strategy only pursues the deniers through delayed consequence.
changed_reading.after: It may also stabilize the addressed messenger and reminder against an opposing pressure that nearly dislodges but does not complete its act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the fire-stick branch of ك ي د and the garden text never names combustion. It remains anchored by an explicit focus branch plus the packet's overnight lull and abrupt severance; downstream prose should present it only as an incubation analogy, never as a claim that the garden burned.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins long extension to a ك ي د branch in which fire emerges slowly and to extended firmness.

activation_trace.role: Extended time supplies an incubation period.
A fire-stick slow to bring out fire supplies delayed ignition as the material analogy.
Extended firmness lets latent efficacy persist until emergence.
Sleep as hiddenness and heedlessness supplies the phenomenological lull before effect.
Abrupt severance supplies emergence of a completed result after latency.

changed_reading.before: Delay is inert waiting before force appears.
changed_reading.after: Delay may be incubation, like effortful fire held latent until its effect emerges.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus pronoun concerns the deniers, whereas 68:49 describes a different recipient overtaken by grace. It remains valuable because the exact focus head-start branch meets an explicit catching-up root nearby; downstream prose should use it to widen the temporal architecture, not to replace the focus referent or turn its strategy into grace alone.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Long respite and the head-start-then-catch branch of مَتِين make overtaking part of the focus's live temporal geometry.

activation_trace.role: Long temporal extension supplies the distance across which an overtaking agent can arrive.
The focus strategy keeps the overtaking geometry anchored in the ayah even when context reveals a different agent of pursuit.
Giving a lead and catching up supplies the focus's overtaking template.
Catching up and reaching supplies an explicit contextual realization of overtaking.
Beneficent grace supplies a non-punitive agent that can occupy the same catch-up geometry.

changed_reading.before: Whatever catches up after a granted lead can only be punitive strategy.
changed_reading.after: The sequence leaves the catch-up geometry morally bifurcated: firm timing can culminate in consequence, while grace can also overtake before casting-off.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising and visceral because it combines the departing-breath branch of ك ي د with cord-tightening in م ت ن and a nearby blocked outlet whose immediate referent is not the deniers. It remains focus-anchored through two exact focus branches and temporal extension; downstream prose should mark it as a bodily analogy for accumulating constraint, not a literal prediction of a mode of punishment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أُمْلِى extends the process, while كَيْد and مَتِين each contain branches of bodily struggle and tightening.

activation_trace.role: Temporal extension supplies drawn-out accumulation rather than instant closure.
Struggle as breath or soul departs supplies the visceral constriction image.
Tightening with sinew or cords supplies progressive structural constriction.
Sealing an outlet after fullness supplies a nearby image of pressure held within a closed passage.

changed_reading.before: The strong plan waits and then acts from outside.
changed_reading.after: The waiting can be imagined as pressure accumulating through a progressively tightened and finally closed system.

strongest_changes: The immediate graded-taking cue changes respite from stationary postponement into movement by successive controlled steps.
The garden sequence changes delay into a diagnostic interval that matures intention and then overtakes confident advance.
The writing frame activates the focus verb's dictation branch, making duration potentially authored rather than blank.
The final near-displacement scene opens an exploratory contrast between destabilizing counter-pressure and a station-preserving firm strategy.
summary.what_was_special: Three focus roots produce unusually concrete temporal mechanics: a strategy can work through extended time, concede and erase a lead, loosen visible tether while retaining tensile control, or dictate the interval as a durable line. Context distributes rather than collapses these readings across a garden test, a forensic challenge, stepwise taking, and attempted dislodging.
remaining_uncertainties: The dictation branch is genuinely present, but ordinary syntax still strongly favors granting respite.
The racing, tether, slow-fire, and constriction models are material analogies rather than direct lexical glosses of the whole clause.
The KWD-to-KYD echo depends on a non-dominant split mapping and may be a useful activation without being deliberate wordplay.
Grace catching up in 68:49 may widen only the temporal architecture and need not alter the punitive referent of 68:45.
